description: The stored Amazon SELLER PROFILE for one seller - by seller id (the 'A...' code in /sp?seller=... or the seller_id on an offer) or by the seller/operator name the other tools use. RETURNS the seller's star rating, lifetime and 12-month rating counts, positive-feedback % (with its period), feedback per period (30 d / 90 d / 12 m / lifetime: average rating + count), the rating histogram, up to 5 recent feedback entries (date / rating / struck ONLY - never a buyer's name or text), the business block where the seller publishes one on Amazon (legal name, registration / VAT numbers, address, phone, e-mail, representative; null on au/ca), and tracking (since when and how often Webotee has observed the seller). include_history=true adds the rating-change points and storefront-size points, oldest first, UTC. USE WHEN the user asks who a seller is, how it is rated, whether its rating moved, or wants the legal entity behind a storefront. It reads Webotee's seller store (re-read about every 14 days) - it never fetches Amazon live; a seller not stored yet answers not_yet_tracked. For what a seller SELLS use the operator_* tools. Amazon marketplaces only.

history_points.description: include_history=true: the latest N change points per series (1-200).

include_history.description: Append history: rating change points + storefront-size points (oldest first, UTC).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

operator_name.description: The seller / operator display name as the operator_* tools return it (resolved to a seller id on the chosen marketplace; the id wins when both are given).

seller_id.description: Amazon seller id: 'A' + 8-24 letters/digits. Give this OR operator_name.

name: seller_profile
